title: Reflection preservation and focused manuscript or bank proposals

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Verify full original reflection and original date are preserved in the canonical ledger before distillation.
Work forward on the current developing chapter; record conceptual significance, tensions, chapter/location/action/reason.
Compare both published and banked inventory and Published-as markers before one-thought candidacy.
Keep exact-session voice observations separate from inferred profiles; preferred voice confirmation remains a binding requirement.
Queue fields are Date, Title, One thought, Source, Status, File link; candidate dates at least seven days apart.

success_checks: Read back original-preservation reference and private proposal with one claim and one sourced example.
Proposal, draft, banked, scheduled and published remain distinct; only actual accepted state is reported.
Missing preferred voice or publication inventory is explicit; no invented anecdote, source or approval.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
